title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: I deserve to be the highest-paid wide receiver in the NFL

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: I deserve to be the highest-paid wide receiver in the NFL
sources.description: "I would play this game for free, I love this game so much, but you don't have to. I'm learning to be a good businessman, and we need that check at the end of the day," Smith-Njigba said.
